title: Pumpkin and Ginger Sorbet
changes_from_base: Pumpkin purée cooked with cloudy apple juice, fresh ginger and warm spices replaces the mango and lime.
summary: An autumn sorbet of pumpkin purée cooked with cloudy apple juice, fresh ginger and warm spices.

ingredients.item: smooth pumpkin or butternut purée (tinned or homemade)
fresh ginger, peeled and very finely chopped

steps.title: Spice
steps.text: Whisk the pumpkin with 250 ml of the apple juice in the pan until smooth, then add the ginger, spices, brown sugar and honey.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Bring to a gentle simmer and cook on low for 15 min, stirring now and then, so the spices lose their raw taste.

steps.title: Loosen
steps.text: Tip into the bowl and whisk in the rest of the juice and the vanilla. Chill for at least 4 h, or overnight.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn until thick, like soft mashed potato, 30-45 min.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze for at least 2 h. It sets hard, so move it to the fridge 30-60 min before scooping.

tips: Use plain pumpkin purée, not spiced pie filling.
Cloudy pressed apple juice tastes fuller than clear juice.
Top with toasted pumpkin seeds for crunch.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
